zh: 2026年7月19日，首届48队世界杯在纽约MetLife体育场落下帷幕。经过39天、横跨美加墨三国16座城市、104场比赛的激战，西班牙在决赛中通过加时赛1-0击败卫冕冠军阿根廷，继2010年南非世界杯后第二次捧起大力神杯。
这场决赛被誉为“传承之战”——18岁的西班牙天才拉明·亚马尔与39岁的利昂内尔·梅西正面交锋。这是梅西职业生涯的最后一届世界杯，他在半决赛中送出两次助攻，率领阿根廷连续第二届闯入决赛，但最终未能卫冕。常规时间双方互交白卷，西班牙在加时赛中打入制胜一球，为这场史诗对决画上句号。
法国球星基利安·姆巴佩以8粒进球荣膺金靴奖，但他在半决赛中未能攻破西班牙的大门——西班牙凭借奥亚萨瓦尔的点球和佩德罗·波罗的进球2-0完胜法国。另一场半决赛，阿根廷在先丢一球的情况下2-1逆转英格兰，恩佐·费尔南德斯扳平比分，劳塔罗·马丁内斯打入制胜球。
季军争夺战上演了一场罕见的进球盛宴，英格兰6-4击败法国夺得季军，创造了队史自1966年夺冠以来的最佳战绩。本届世界杯首次迎来世界排名前四的球队（阿根廷、西班牙、法国、英格兰）会师半决赛，欧洲球队占据三席。
黑马同样书写历史：摩洛哥3-0完胜东道主加拿大，成为本届最大惊喜之一，历史性地闯入八强；人口仅50余万的佛得角作为世界杯历史上最小的参赛国成功晋级32强；哈兰德领衔的挪威在1/8决赛中2-1掀翻巴西，最终惜败于贝林厄姆第93分钟的绝杀。东道主美国、墨西哥、加拿大均从小组出线，加拿大更是取得队史首场淘汰赛胜利。
从6月11日墨西哥城阿兹特克体育场的揭幕战，到7月19日纽约的巅峰之夜，首届48队世界杯以前所未有的规模，为全球球迷奉献了一届难忘的足球盛宴。
en: On July 19, 2026, the first-ever 48-team FIFA World Cup came to a close at MetLife Stadium in New York. After 39 days, 104 matches across 16 cities in three host nations, Spain defeated defending champions Argentina 1-0 in extra time to lift their second World Cup trophy, adding to their 2010 triumph in South Africa.

The final was billed as a battle of generations — 18-year-old Spanish prodigy Lamine Yamal against 39-year-old Lionel Messi, playing in his last World Cup. Messi had provided both assists in the semi-final to lead Argentina to back-to-back finals, but could not retain the title. After a goalless 90 minutes, Spain scored the decisive goal in extra time to settle the epic encounter.

France's Kylian Mbappé won the Golden Boot with 8 goals, though he was kept scoreless in the semi-final as Spain beat France 2-0 through an Oyarzabal penalty and a Pedro Porro strike. In the other semi-final, Argentina came from behind to defeat England 2-1, with Enzo Fernández equalizing and Lautaro Martínez scoring the winner.

The third-place playoff produced a remarkable ten-goal thriller, with England beating France 6-4 to claim bronze — their best World Cup finish since winning it all in 1966. For the first time in history, the world's top four FIFA-ranked teams (Argentina, Spain, France and England) all reached the semi-finals, with Europe claiming three of the four spots.

Underdogs also made history: Morocco stunned co-hosts Canada 3-0 to reach the quarter-finals; Cape Verde, the smallest nation ever to play at a World Cup, advanced to the Round of 32; and Erling Haaland's Norway knocked out Brazil 2-1 before falling to Jude Bellingham's 93rd-minute winner for England. All three co-hosts — the USA, Mexico and Canada — advanced from the group stage, with Canada recording their first-ever knockout round victory.

From the opening match at Mexico City's Estadio Azteca on June 11 to the climactic night in New York on July 19, the first 48-team World Cup delivered an unforgettable festival of football on an unprecedented scale.
